- Handle edge cases: if k == 0 return []; if k == len(arr) sort arr and return; ensure arr length and k constraints are respected.
- Use a min-heap of size k to track top k values: iterate through arr, push value; if heap size exceeds k, pop smallest; this yields k largest values without sorting entire array (O(n log k)).
- Extract heap elements, sort them in nondecreasing order, and return the sorted list.
